## Checklist
- [ ] App builds green in **Debug** and **Release**
- [ ] `scripts/test-engines.sh` passes (engine unit tests)
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_datasets.py` passes (if data changed)
- [ ] No new third-party dependency (or it's justified + documented)

## Privacy & safety
- [ ] No personal financial data is transmitted off-device
- [ ] No secrets/keys/credentials committed
- [ ] Source citations and methodology disclosures preserved
- [ ] No individualized financial/investment/legal/tax advice added

## Accessibility (if UI changed)
- [ ] Dynamic Type checked at large sizes
- [ ] VoiceOver labels/order sensible; no meaning by color alone
- [ ] Light + dark, WCAG-AA contrast, Reduce Motion respected
